name: Financial Data API
description: Financial data API for Python and the command line: stock quotes, crypto prices, DeFi TVL, ECB exchange rates, LEI records and SEC EDGAR filings in one client, with one sign-in and the same JSON or CSV rows for every source. Free and open source; runs on your QuanticData account.

commands.name: marketwatch
commands.help: stock quotes from MarketWatch by ticker
commands.description: Latest quote per US ticker from MarketWatch: price, change, session, day and 52-week range, volume, market cap, P/E and EPS, with the time the quote is from.

inputs.name: tickers
inputs.description: US-listed ticker symbols as MarketWatch spells them, e.g. AAPL MSFT BRK.B.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many quotes to deliver at most (1–25). You pay only for delivered quotes.

commands.name: crypto
commands.help: crypto market data from CoinGecko, by coin id or ranking
commands.description: Crypto market rows from CoinGecko, for chosen coins or in market-cap order: price, market cap, volume, 24-hour range and change, supply and all-time high and low.

inputs.name: vs_currency
inputs.description: Quote currency: usd, eur, btc...

inputs.name: coin_ids
inputs.description: CoinGecko coin ids, e.g. bitcoin ethereum solana. Omit them for the market-cap ranking.

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: Only coins of this CoinGecko category, e.g. stablecoins or meme-token.

inputs.name: order
inputs.description: Sort order (default market_cap_desc).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many coins to deliver at most (1–250). You pay only for delivered coins.

commands.name: defi
commands.help: DeFi total value locked per chain from DefiLlama
commands.description: Total value locked per blockchain from DefiLlama, in USD, with its rank and share across all chains, the native token and the chain's CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap ids.

inputs.name: chains
inputs.description: Chain names, e.g. Ethereum Solana Arbitrum. Omit them for every chain, ranked by TVL.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many chains to deliver at most (1–200). You pay only for delivered chains.

commands.name: fx
commands.help: foreign-exchange rates from ECB reference data
commands.description: Foreign-exchange rates from the European Central Bank reference data, latest or for a past date, one row per target currency with the inverse rate.

inputs.name: base
inputs.description: Base currency, 3 letters, e.g. EUR (default USD).

inputs.name: symbols
inputs.description: Target currencies, e.g. USD GBP JPY. Omit them for every currency available.

inputs.name: date
inputs.description: A past date, YYYY-MM-DD; omit it for the latest rates.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many currencies to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered currencies.

commands.name: lei
commands.help: Legal Entity Identifier records from GLEIF
commands.description: LEI records from GLEIF, by legal name or exact LEI: legal name and other names, entity and registration status, legal and headquarters addresses, legal form, register number, BIC codes and renewal date.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Legal name to search, e.g. "Apple Inc", or an exact 20-character LEI.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Limit to entities whose legal address is in this country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many entities to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered entities.

commands.name: sec
commands.help: SEC EDGAR filings by full-text search or company
commands.description: SEC EDGAR filings: full-text search across every filing, or one company's filing history by ticker or CIK, with form, dates, accession number and links to the document and its index.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Full-text search across every filing, e.g. "artificial intelligence risk factors". Use this or --ticker / --cik.

inputs.name: ticker
inputs.description: Company ticker, e.g. AAPL, for that company's filing history.

inputs.name: cik
inputs.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193, instead of a ticker.

inputs.name: forms
inputs.description: Filter to a form type, e.g. 10-K, 8-K, S-1. Comma-separate several: 10-K,10-Q.

inputs.name: date_from
inputs.description: Earliest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.name: date_to
inputs.description: Latest filing date, YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many filings to deliver at most (1–100). You pay only for delivered filings.
